{"description":"Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description

## 14.8 TDMA CCP FSM Requirements Checklist

### SFN Modulo and Time-Provider Interaction
- [ ] MUST: SFN delta computation uses unsigned 32-bit arithmetic (modulo 2^32)
- [ ] MUST: Implementation uses language-native unsigned 32-bit subtraction for SFN_delta(curr, last)
- [ ] MUST: SFN derivation/validation from wall-clock only uses samples where wall_clock_valid=true AND unix_time >= effective_epoch_floor
- [ ] MUST: Reject SFN updates derived from timestamps failing epoch_floor validation

### Test Vectors
- [ ] MUST: All SFN edge cases (wraparound, desync recovery FSM transitions, multi-root beacon conflicts, RPL version changes during join/drift) covered by test vectors (ccp16.json, ccp_tdma.json)

### Initialization Order (per AGENTS.md graph)
- [ ] MUST: Follow lichen_node_init() ordering to avoid use-before-init
- [ ] MUST: lichen_link_init() precedes lichen_link_load_key()
- [ ] MUST: lichen_link_init() precedes lichen_rpl_dodag_init()
- [ ] MUST: lichen_link_init() precedes TDMA
- [ ] MUST: lichen_link_init() precedes oscore_init()
- [ ] MUST: lichen_link_init() precedes lichen_coap_client_init()

### FSM State Transitions
- [ ] MUST: Reset all timers on state transition
- [ ] MUST: Beacons with invalid/missing signatures silently discarded
- [ ] MUST: UNJOINED -> ACQUIRING on lichen_node_init(eui64, seed)
- [ ] MUST: ACQUIRING -> SYNCED on valid beacon (signature verified, higher stratum/version)
- [ ] MUST: SYNCED -> DRIFTING on >3 missed beacons or RPL version increment
- [ ] MUST: DRIFTING beacons with signature fail silently discarded, continue listen

### Timing
- [ ] MUST: Rejoin timeout = 10 x superframe length (CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA_REJOIN_TIMEOUT, default 10s)
- [ ] MUST: Beacon timeout in ACQUIRING = 3 x superframe

### Referenced from 02a-coordinated-capacity.md
- [ ] MUST: Slot ID = fnv1a32(EUI64 XOR SFN) % num_slots
- [ ] MUST: Beacons signed with Schnorr48, signature covers bytes 0..(E-48)
- [ ] MUST: Receivers verify signature against sender public key before accepting slot/time updates
- [ ] MUST NOT: Relay beacons whose Schnorr48 signature fails verification
- [ ] MUST: Transmit only in assigned slot
- [ ] MUST: Slot duration = max_airtime(current_SF) + 100ms guard

### Multi-Root Beacon Conflict (from 02a-coordinated-capacity.md 2a.5)
- [ ] MUST: Verify Schnorr48 signature before evaluating any selection criteria
- [ ] MUST: Discard beacon immediately if signature verification fails
- [ ] MUST NOT: Cause any state transition from failed signature
- [ ] MUST: Select root using ordered criteria (DODAG Preference, Stratum, RSSI/SNR, EUI-64 tiebreak)
- [ ] MUST: Defer root transition for 3 superframes hold-off period
- [ ] MUST: Reset SFN relative to new root epoch on version change

### SHOULD Statements
- [ ] SHOULD: Log signature failures for diagnostics
- [ ] SHOULD: Select root with highest RSSI/SNR when DODAG Preference and stratum equal"}
